# MusicAvet

> A public music library for browsing songs, albums, artists, and genres.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://musicavet.vercel.app/)
- [Songs](https://musicavet.vercel.app/songs)
- [Artists](https://musicavet.vercel.app/artists)
- [Albums](https://musicavet.vercel.app/albums)
- [Genres](https://musicavet.vercel.app/genres)
